CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_add_tester(p_username text, p_name text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  uname text := lower(regexp_replace(btrim(p_username), '^@', ''));
begin
  if not public.is_admin_user() then raise exception 'forbidden'; end if;
  if uname !~ '^[a-z0-9_]{3,32}$' then raise exception 'bad_username'; end if;
  insert into public.allowed_users (username, display_name, status)
  values (uname, nullif(btrim(p_name), ''), 'invited')
  on conflict (username) do nothing;
  if not found then raise exception 'already_exists'; end if;
end
$function$
functions.name: admin_add_tester

functions.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_set_status(p_id uuid, p_status text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if not public.is_admin_user() then raise exception 'forbidden'; end if;
  if p_status not in ('active', 'blocked') then raise exception 'bad_status'; end if;
  if p_id = public.my_allowed_id() then raise exception 'cannot_change_self'; end if;
  update public.allowed_users
     set status = p_status,
         active_sid = case when p_status = 'blocked' then null else active_sid end
   where id = p_id;
  if not found then raise exception 'user_not_found'; end if;
end
$function$
functions.name: admin_set_status

functions.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_testers()
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, username text, display_name text, status text, is_admin boolean, last_login_ms bigint, invite_issued_ms bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if not public.is_admin_user() then raise exception 'forbidden'; end if;
  return query
    select a.id, a.username, a.display_name, a.status, a.is_admin,
           (extract(epoch from a.last_login_at) * 1000)::bigint,
           (extract(epoch from a.invite_issued_at) * 1000)::bigint
    from public.allowed_users a
    order by a.is_admin desc, a.created_at;
end
$function$
functions.name: admin_testers

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.current_sid()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  select nullif(coalesce(nullif(current_setting('request.headers', true), ''), '{}')::json ->> 'x-sid', '')
$function$
functions.name: current_sid

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.end_session()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  update public.allowed_users set active_sid = null
  where auth_user_id = auth.uid() and active_sid = public.current_sid()
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_active_user()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.allowed_users a
    where a.auth_user_id = auth.uid()
      and a.status <> 'blocked'
      and a.active_sid is not null
      and a.active_sid = public.current_sid()
  )
$function$
functions.name: is_active_user

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_admin_user()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.allowed_users a
    where a.auth_user_id = auth.uid()
      and a.is_admin
      and a.status <> 'blocked'
      and a.active_sid is not null
      and a.active_sid = public.current_sid()

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.leaderboard_accuracy()
 RETURNS TABLE(name text, accuracy numeric, answers integer, is_me boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  me uuid := public.my_allowed_id();
begin
  if me is null then raise exception 'session_replaced'; end if;   -- лише для тестерів з активним сеансом
  return query
    select coalesce(nullif(a.display_name, ''), a.username)::text as name,
           round(p.answers_correct::numeric * 100 / p.answers_total, 1) as accuracy,
           p.answers_total as answers,
           (a.id = me) as is_me
      from public.progress p
      join public.allowed_users a on a.id = p.user_id
     where a.status = 'active'
       and not a.is_admin
       and p.answers_total >= 10
     order by 2 desc, 3 desc, 1 asc   -- номери колонок: імена збігаються зі змінними plpgsql
     limit 100;
end
$function$
functions.name: leaderboard_accuracy

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.my_allowed_id()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select a.id from public.allowed_users a
  where a.auth_user_id = auth.uid()
    and a.status <> 'blocked'
    and a.active_sid is not null
    and a.active_sid = public.current_sid()
$function$
functions.name: my_allowed_id

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.session_me()
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select json_build_object(
    'id', a.id,
    'telegram_id', a.telegram_id,
    'username', a.username,
    'display_name', a.display_name,
    'is_admin', a.is_admin,
    'session_ok', (a.status <> 'blocked' and a.active_sid is not null and a.active_sid = public.current_sid())
  )
  from public.allowed_users a
  where a.auth_user_id = auth.uid()
  limit 1
$function$
functions.name: session_me

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.throttle_hit(p_key text, p_limit integer, p_window_seconds integer)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  c int;
begin
  insert into public.login_throttle as t (key, window_start, count) values (p_key, now(), 1)
  on conflict (key) do update set
    count = case when t.window_start < now() - make_interval(secs => p_window_seconds) then 1 else t.count + 1 end,
    window_start = case when t.window_start < now() - make_interval(secs => p_window_seconds) then now() else t.window_start end
  returning count into c;
  -- прибираємо старі записи (раз на ~100 викликів), щоб таблиця не росла
  if random() < 0.01 then delete from public.login_throttle where window_start < now() - interval '1 day'; end if;
  return c <= p_limit;
end
$function$
functions.args: p_key text, p_limit integer, p_window_seconds integer
functions.name: throttle_hit
